parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: Clap the beats
steps.prompt: Tap each animal and clap along.
steps.explanation: Each beat in a word is a syllable. Cat has one, tiger has two.
steps.shortExplanation: Each beat in a word is a syllable. Cat has one, tiger has two.

steps.title: Describing words
steps.explanation: Adjectives are describing words: they tell us what something is like.
steps.shortExplanation: Adjectives are describing words: they tell us what something is like.

steps.title: How many claps?
steps.prompt: How many syllables in each animal name?
steps.hint: Put your hand under your chin. Each time it drops is one syllable.
steps.explanation: Cat has 1 syllable, mon-key 2, el-e-phant 3 and al-li-ga-tor 4.
steps.shortExplanation: Cat has 1 syllable, mon-key 2, el-e-phant 3 and al-li-ga-tor 4.

steps.title: Animal rhymes
steps.prompt: Match each animal to the animal that rhymes with it.
steps.hint: Say both names aloud. Do they end the same?
steps.explanation: Goat and stoat, moose and goose, seal and eel rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Goat and stoat, moose and goose, seal and eel rhyme.

source.answerKeyText: goat – stoat • moose – goose • seal – eel

steps.title: Find the adjectives
steps.prompt: The big hippo. A stripy zebra. A hairy spider. Tap the three describing words.
steps.hint: Is it the animal, or what the animal is like?
steps.explanation: Big, stripy and hairy describe the animals. They are adjectives.
steps.shortExplanation: Big, stripy and hairy describe the animals. They are adjectives.

source.answerKeyText: a big • b stripy • c hairy

steps.title: What does it do?
steps.prompt: Match each animal to a verb that fits.
steps.hint: Act out each animal. What do you do?
steps.explanation: Monkeys swing, snakes slide, frogs hop and lions roar.
steps.shortExplanation: Monkeys swing, snakes slide, frogs hop and lions roar.

source.answerKeyText: monkey – swings • snake – slides • frog – hops • lion – roars

steps.title: Quiet or noisy?
steps.prompt: Is each verb quiet or noisy?
steps.hint: Say each word in the voice it describes.
steps.explanation: Whispering and rustling are quiet. Roaring and crashing are noisy.
steps.shortExplanation: Whispering and rustling are quiet. Roaring and crashing are noisy.

source.answerKeyText: whispering Q • roaring N • rustling Q • crashing N

steps.title: Letters that work together
steps.hint: Say the whole word: spider, drop, crawl.
steps.explanation: Spider starts with sp, drop with dr and crawl with cr.
steps.shortExplanation: Spider starts with sp, drop with dr and crawl with cr.

steps.title: Describe the crocodile
steps.prompt: Which word could describe a crocodile?
steps.hint: Which word tells us what the crocodile is like?
steps.explanation: Golden is a describing word: a golden crocodile.
steps.shortExplanation: Golden is a describing word: a golden crocodile.

source.answerKeyText: Any describing word, e.g. a golden / green / hungry crocodile, a big / proud / hairy lion

steps.title: My list poem
steps.prompt: Monkeys swing. Snakes slide. Which line fits next in the list poem?
steps.hint: Each line is an animal and what it does.
steps.explanation: Frogs hop has an animal and a verb, like the other lines.
steps.shortExplanation: Frogs hop has an animal and a verb, like the other lines.

source.answerKeyText: Three lines, each an animal and a verb (e.g. Monkeys swing. Snakes slide. Frogs hop.). Adjectives are a bonus.

steps.title: Clap tiger
steps.prompt: How many syllables are in tiger?
steps.explanation: Ti-ger has two claps, so it has 2 syllables.
steps.shortExplanation: Ti-ger has two claps, so it has 2 syllables.

steps.title: What is an adjective?
steps.hint: Stripy, big and hairy are adjectives.
steps.explanation: An adjective describes a thing, like a stripy zebra.
steps.shortExplanation: An adjective describes a thing, like a stripy zebra.

steps.title: Rhymes with goose
steps.explanation: Goose and moose both end with oose, so they rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Goose and moose both end with oose, so they rhyme.

steps.title: Reading a poem aloud
steps.prompt: To make a poem interesting to listen to, read it with…

options.label: a loud, soft, fast and slow voice

steps.hint: How does a roaring lion sound? And a creeping spider?
steps.explanation: A poem is more fun with a loud, soft, fast and slow voice.
steps.shortExplanation: A poem is more fun with a loud, soft, fast and slow voice.

source.answerKeyText: a loud, soft, fast and slow voice

steps.title: Four claps
steps.prompt: Which animal name has four syllables?
steps.explanation: Al-li-ga-tor has four claps, so it has 4 syllables.
steps.shortExplanation: Al-li-ga-tor has four claps, so it has 4 syllables.

stickers.meaning: A beat in a word. Ti-ger has two.

goalActivities.text: Try the chin trick: put the back of your child's hand under their chin and say a word slowly. Every time the chin drops is one syllable.
goalActivities.textAr: جرّبوا حركة الدقن: حط ضهر إيد طفلك تحت دقنه وقول كلمة ببطء. كل ما الدقن تنزل يبقى مقطع واحد.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Make up silly animal rhymes together: a goat in a coat, a cat on a mat, a moose on the loose.
goalActivities.textAr: ألّفوا قوافي حيوانات تضحّك مع بعض: a goat in a coat و a cat on a mat و a moose on the loose.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Play "I spy" with describing words: I spy something soft… something shiny… something round.
goalActivities.textAr: العبوا "أنا شايف" بكلمات وصف: شايف حاجة طرية… حاجة بتلمع… حاجة مدوّرة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Make a fridge list poem: write animals and verbs on paper strips, match them, and stick them up: Monkeys swing. Snakes slide.
goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا قصيدة ليستة على التلاجة: اكتبوا حيوانات وأفعال على شرايط ورق، وصّلوهم ببعض، والزقوهم: Monkeys swing. Snakes slide.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Say Incy Wincy Spider together with a voice dial: loud, soft, fast, slow. Which voice fits the climbing spider?
goalActivities.textAr: قولوا أغنية Incy Wincy Spider مع بعض بصوت مختلف كل شوية: عالي، واطي، سريع، بطيء. أنهي صوت يليق بالعنكبوت وهو بيطلع؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Write sp, dr and cr on cards. Your child finds a word for each one: spoon, drum, crab.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتبوا sp و dr و cr على كروت، وطفلك يلاقي كلمة لكل واحدة: spoon و drum و crab.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Pick a soft toy animal and find three describing words for it together: soft, brown, cuddly.
goalActivities.textAr: اختاروا لعبة حيوان طرية ولاقوا تلات كلمات وصف ليها مع بعض: soft و brown و cuddly.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Write a three-line animal list poem together. Each line has an animal and what it does. Add a describing word for a bonus.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتبوا قصيدة ليستة من تلات سطور مع بعض. كل سطر فيه حيوان وبيعمل إيه، وزوّدوا كلمة وصف كبونص.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Clap the names of everyone in the family. Whose name has the most claps?
goalActivities.textAr: صقفوا أسامي كل العيلة. اسم مين فيه أكتر صقفات؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Describe your child with three adjectives, then let them describe you: kind, funny, tall.
goalActivities.textAr: اوصف طفلك بتلات صفات، وبعدين خلّيه يوصفك: kind و funny و tall.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Look at animal pictures together and find two that rhyme: goat and stoat, moose and goose.
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا على صور حيوانات مع بعض ولاقوا اتنين على نفس القافية: goat و stoat، و moose و goose.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Read a short poem together twice: once in a flat voice, once with loud, soft, fast and slow parts. Which is more fun?
goalActivities.textAr: اقروا قصيدة قصيرة مع بعض مرتين: مرة بصوت واحد، ومرة بأجزاء عالية وواطية وسريعة وبطيئة. أنهي أحلى؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Find long animal names together: caterpillar, armadillo, tarantula. Clap each one.
goalActivities.textAr: دوّروا على أسامي حيوانات طويلة مع بعض: caterpillar و armadillo و tarantula. وصقفوا كل واحد.

homeActivities.text: Put out things from the kitchen: a cup, a teapot, a banana. Guess how many claps each word has, then clap to check. Can you find one with four?
homeActivities.textAr: حطّوا حاجات من المطبخ: كباية، براد شاي، موزة. خمّنوا كل كلمة فيها كام صقفة، وبعدين صقفوا عشان تتأكدوا. تلاقوا كلمة فيها أربعة؟
